summary_en: note inc. announced execution of share buyback up to 347,500 shares (1.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion via ToSTNeT-3 on October 28, 2026, at the closing price of ¥2,877 on October 27, 2026, to secure treasury shares for M&A consideration and equity compensation programs.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
note inc. announced on October 27, 2026, that it will execute a share buyback using the Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-hours trading system (ToSTNeT-3) on October 28, 2026. The company intends to acquire up to 347,500 shares, representing 1.8% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total of ¥1.0 billion. The purchase will be executed at the closing price of ¥2,877 on October 27, 2026.

The board of directors approved the acquisition to secure treasury shares that can be flexibly deployed for future M&A consideration and equity compensation programs as part of the company's growth strategy. The company stated it will use cash on hand for the acquisition while maintaining sufficient funds for growth investments. The purchase order is limited to the specified trading window, and results will be announced immediately after the trading session ends.

The company disclosed that Image Frame Investment (HK) Limited, a shareholder, has indicated its intention to participate in the buyback by offering some of its shares. As of August 31, 2026, the company had 19,417,344 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
